mapper.select: select r.rec_user_id userId, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, d.role role, d.hide_role hideRole, d.group `group`, d.hide_group `hideGroup`, d.hide_prefer_group `hidePreferGroup`, d.con con, d.relation, d.check_status checkStatus, d.weight, d.height, d.birthday, p.uptime time from corgi_user_recommend r left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = r.rec_user_id left join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = r.rec_user_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.`status` = '0' and not exists (select 1 from corgi_user_follow f where f.user_id = #{userId} and f.follow_user_id = r.rec_user_id) and r.rec_user_id != #{userId} order by r.`weight` desc limit #{size}
mapper.insert: insert into corgi_influencer_billboard(user_id, nickname, fan, city) select d.user_id, d.nickname, count(1) fan, p.city from corgi_user_detail d left join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = d.user_id left join corgi_user_follow f on f.follow_user_id = d.user_id and f.is_deleted = '0' where d.avatar_status = 'influencer' group by d.user_id
mapper.select: select max(c.activity_id) from corgi_influencer_billboard b left join corgi_activity_creator c on c.creator_id = b.user_id where b.city = #{city} and not exists(select 1 from corgi_user_recommend r where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.rec_user_id = b.user_id and r.status = '2') and b.user_id != '8' and c.category = 'image' group by b.user_id order by b.fan desc limit #{start}, #{size}

select max(c.activity_id) from corgi_influencer_billboard b left join corgi_activity_creator c on c.creator_id = b.user_id where b.city != #{city} and not exists (select 1 from corgi_user_recommend r where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.rec_user_id = b.user_id and r.status = '2') and b.user_id != '8' and c.category = 'image' group by b.user_id order by b.fan desc limit #{start}, #{size}
